caption:
Quick myth-buster. ✅

Freezing your credit is free, by federal law.

It doesn't lower your score.

You can lift it temporarily when you apply for credit.

Have you ever frozen yours?
first_comment: Have you frozen your credit? Yes or no? 👇

card.headline: A credit freeze is free and won't hurt your score.
card.sub: You can lift it when you apply for credit.
